## Rough Cut Checklist
- [ ] Story arc assembled from selects
- [ ] Pacing reviewed — no dead air or dragging segments
- [ ] All key talking points / moments included
- [ ] Transitions between segments smooth
- [ ] Audio synced across all sources
- [ ] Rough cut exported for internal review

## Audio Post-Production
- [ ] Dialogue cleaned (noise reduction, EQ, compression)
- [ ] Audio levels balanced across speakers
- [ ] Music bed selected and placed
- [ ] Music levels ducked under dialogue
- [ ] Sound effects added (if applicable)
- [ ] Room tone fills applied to gaps

## Visual Post-Production
- [ ] Color correction applied
- [ ] Color grade / look applied
- [ ] Lower thirds / name cards added
- [ ] Title cards / intro animation added
- [ ] B-roll inserted over jump cuts
- [ ] Graphics / overlays added
- [ ] End screen / subscribe CTA added
